reader.notes: GRL2.1 is the parser predicate itself: logicalNotBeforeRelationalOperator excludes exactly GREATER, >, LESS, <, EQUAL, = (and NOT), so those NOTs parse inside comparisonOperator and every other NOT before an operator takes negatedAbbreviatedRelation, bound at 85 as BoundNot with the stated operator carried. The exhaustive 81-combination truth-table probe found no mismatch.

refuter.evidence: The 1985 abbreviation format (rendered PDF page 293, folio VI-61) is 'relation-condition {{AND|OR} [NOT] [relational-operator] object}...', and the relational-operator table (PDF page 287, VI-55) prints 'IS [NOT] <' with IS not underlined (optional). So 'A > B OR NOT NOT < C' is [NOT] + relational-operator 'NOT <' (IS omitted) + object. GRL2.1/GRL2.2 then read it: the first NOT is followed by NOT, which is not GREATER, >, LESS, <, EQUAL or =, so 'otherwise' it is the logical operator; the second NOT is followed by < and joins the operator; expansion (A > B) OR (NOT (A NOT < C)). Table 1's 'NOT NOT' bar governs 'The result of such implied insertion' (§1985:VI.6.3.3 SR2-located text, cite OK), and the result 'NOT A NOT < C' contains no NOT NOT pair (NOT followed by a simple-condition, which Table 1 permits). Probe refute-1985-021/abn3.cob --std 85 (abn3-001): COBOL0001 'cannot parse construct near NOT' at 'A > B OR NOT NOT < C', 'OR NOT NOT = C', 'OR NOT NOT LESS C', while 'A > B OR NOT IS NOT < C' (the same operator with its optional IS) compiles; abn2.cob --std 85 (abn2-001): 11 further forms x 81 combinations all MISMATCH 000, incl. 'A > B AND NOT IS NOT < C' (TRUE 003), 'A > B AND NOT = C OR NOT D', 'A > B OR NOT IS NOT = C', 'A NOT > B OR NOT >= C OR NOT D'. Same refusal at --std 2023 (abn3-002). Code: CobolParserCoreBase.cs#logicalNotBeforeRelationalOperator lists NOT among the words after which a NOT is NOT logical (LA(2) is not ... or CobolParserCore.NOT), adding a seventh word to GRL2.1's six; the comparisonOperator arm then cannot take 'NOT NOT <', so neither reading exists. kb/Work PB5123/2026-11-14-landed.md asserts 'NOT NOT > C ... stay COBOL0001 at 85, correctly' without argument; no note files it as a defect. cite: OK  §1985:VI.6.3.3 GRL2.1; OK  §1985:VI.6.3.3 GRL2.2 'The NOT is interpreted as a logical operator'; OK  §1985:VI.6.3.1.1 'NOT and the next key word or relation character are one relational operator'; OK  §1985:VI.6.3.2.3 'the pair NOT NOT is not permissible' (Table 1, about the logical-operator element).
